knowledge_graph.title: HOME DEVELOPMENT MUTUAL FUND
knowledge_graph.description: The Home Development Mutual Fund, commonly known as the Pag-IBIG Fund, is a government-owned and controlled corporation under the Department of Human Settlements and Urban Development of the Philippines responsible for the administration of the national savings program and affordable shelter financing for Filipinos.
